questions.title: Transaction guarantees
questions.prompt: Select every statement that correctly describes a database transaction guarantee. Assume an ACID database with durable commits. Select all that apply.
expected_concepts: Atomicity groups changes into an all-or-nothing unit
Durability preserves committed changes after recovery

options.text: Atomicity prevents a failed transaction from leaving only some of its changes committed.
Durability means committed changes survive a crash and recovery.
Atomicity guarantees every query finishes in constant time.
Durability means a transaction never needs concurrency control.

questions.title: Safe HTTP retry reasoning
questions.prompt: A client times out after sending a payment creation request. Select every measure that helps avoid duplicate payments when the client retries. Select all that apply.
expected_concepts: Persist an idempotency key with the operation result
Reject reuse of a key with a different request payload

options.text: Atomically persist an idempotency key and the payment result.
Reject the same key when it is reused for a different payment payload.
Always create a new payment because the first request timed out.
Keep the idempotency key only in the browser's memory.

questions.title: Serializable transaction retries
questions.prompt: A PostgreSQL serializable transaction fails with SQLSTATE 40001. Which responses preserve transactional correctness? Select all that apply. External effects are not transactional.
expected_concepts: Retry the entire transaction with fresh reads
Delay external effects until commit or use a transactional outbox

options.text: Retry the whole transaction, including the reads that informed its writes.
Use an outbox committed with the transaction to schedule external effects safely.
Retry only the last SQL statement inside the failed transaction.
Send an external payment on every retry before attempting to commit.

questions.title: Binary search precondition
questions.prompt: You want to use ordinary binary search to find a number in an array by comparing it with the middle element. Which precondition makes discarding half the search range valid? Choose one.
expected_concepts: The array is sorted under the comparison order

options.text: The array is sorted under the same comparison order used by the search.
The array has an even length.

questions.title: Index read and write tradeoffs
questions.prompt: In a few sentences, explain why adding a database index can speed up a filtered read but slow down inserts or updates. Mention storage and explain why an index is not always selected by the query planner.

questions.title: DNS lookup purpose
questions.prompt: In a few sentences, describe what a DNS lookup does when a browser opens a hostname. Explain how caching helps and why a DNS result alone does not establish an encrypted connection.
